annotations.text:
Three changes from your notes:

1. Pockets are architecture now — the frame swells around each one and the cushions break and flare into the mouth. See "Pockets are not on the table".
2. The palette is allocated. Five channels, no hue in two of them. Pockets have no colour at all; green is always good, red is always bad.
3. Plain words only: hit, shoot, knock in, bounce. Sink, pot, bank and drive-through are gone.
